items.statement: The submission independently optimizes the supplied reference and target geometries and performs vibrational analyses, reporting convergence and charge/multiplicity.
items.expected: Both fixed structures have documented optimization and frequency results with explicit computational settings.

items.statement: The target stationary point is validated as a first-order saddle and its imaginary displacement is assigned to N–O cleavage.
items.expected: Exactly one imaginary frequency is reported for the target and the mode evidence addresses N–O cleavage.

items.statement: The computed Gibbs barrier for N–O cleavage is reported with a defined equation and units.
items.expected: A reproducible numerical barrier in kcal/mol is supplied or a justified bounded failure is documented.
